hooks.name: Kiro tracking check on ignore changes
hooks.description: Checks ignore rules against .kiro and existing configuration, including tracked files. Requires Git and Python 3.

action.command:
python3 - <<'PY_IGNORE'
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
try:
    subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    base = pathlib.Path(".kiro")
    if not base.is_dir():
        print("FAIL: Project .kiro directory is missing.", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    paths = [str(base)] + [str(p) for p in sorted(base.rglob("*")) if p.is_file()]
    result = subprocess.run(["git", "check-ignore", "--no-index", "-v", "--stdin"], input="\n".join(paths) + "\n", text=True, capture_output=True)
    if result.returncode == 0:
        print("REVIEW: Ignore rules match .kiro paths; inspect exclusion and re-inclusion patterns:", file=sys.stderr)
        print(result.stdout, file=sys.stderr, end="")
        sys.exit(1)
    if result.returncode != 1:
        print("ERROR: Git ignore check could not complete.", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
    print("PASS: No ignore rules match .kiro or its existing files.")
except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
    print("ERROR: Git ignore check could not run.", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)
PY_IGNORE
